name: gow3-dev-guard
description: Two-layer deterministic guardrails for the gow3_pc fork: PreToolUse blocks dangerous operations before execution (fail-closed, cd-tracking, git staged/worktree inspection); the trusted-source Audit Gate (audit_gate.py, CLI+CI) verifies the repository's real changes against a trusted reference from the protected base in GitHub Actions — including submodules, blob-proven upstream exceptions (windows-v2.1.7 @ b907d8a9) and class-based self-integrity; Stop validates the GOW3 ZCODE FINAL REPORT; SessionStart injects project context.
